native_routing_contract.GetFolder: All files/subFolders absolutePath strings are projected to opaque locators before any Future can retain them, even before a detector knows a value. Active scan traversal uses an explicitly gated local {files,folders} sink; only an exact get_folder content-profile call accepts it and bypasses cached Futures. _call recomputes opaque route IDs from actual ephemeral paths and checks equality to the safe projection; scan_repository clears the sink in finally.
native_routing_contract.GetFile: Native commitId/filePath/fileSize/bytes type checks still precede scanning; both engines receive bounded bytes and an opaque location. No file bytes or native argument paths persist in safe values or binding.
native_routing_contract.replay: Only complete redacted scans may enter a scan-local replay cache, max4 entries with<=2MiB serialized metadata each. Replay key binds native ARN, Region, branch and commit; repository/branch authority is checked first. Failed/partial scans never populate complete replay. No decrypted/encrypted raw path map or full native response is retained.
